Keep it as the ONE application and referral hook at this company — not because he is eligible, but because it is the only req where a referrer argues for a candidate rather than against a printed bar.

honesty_check: Flattering, and in one place it invented evidence — but its strategic conclusion is sound. Five specific overreaches. (1) The top-scored pick, at 84, is an internship with NO URL; the screen scored an unverifiable third-party rumour above every real, live req it found, and my probes of myinternships.in found no trace of Fractal at all. (2) It FABRICATED an education requirement for SR-42761 — "Education demanded is B.E/B.Tech in CS, which is exactly what he will hold" — that posting has no education line whatsoever. It manufactured a match out of nothing. (3) It called four reqs "stretch" while listing LangChain, LlamaIndex, Bedrock/Vertex/Azure OpenAI, PyTorch/TF/HuggingFace and PEFT/RLHF as "gaps" — the raw text files all of these under "Primary Skills", i.e. required. By the screen's own rule that basic means required, all four are "no". (4) The SR-43796 argument inverts: a live GenAI skills evaluation does not favour a candidate who has never opened the two frameworks being evaluated. (5) The entire "Imagineers" programme — the 28-30 Jan 2026 window, the 7.0 CGPA bar, referral-only submission — is presented as established fact with specific dates and I could corroborate NONE of it from any Fractal-controlled source. He should treat it as a lead to verify with a human, not a calendar entry. What it got RIGHT and deserves credit for: every one of the five Workday links is genuinely live (I verified each against the CXS API with a 404 control), both 30 Nov 2026 end dates are real, the "3 to 5yrs" title bar is real, the "5+ years or equivalent portfolio proof" clause is verbatim accurate, and the core verdict — that Fractal's portal is structurally closed to a May-2027 graduate and the only real door is a referral into a campus intake — is correct, and I independently confirmed it: zero intern, trainee, graduate or campus reqs exist across all 137 Fractal jobs globally, with "campus" returning literally zero results.
final_recommendation: Spend exactly ONE application at Fractal, on SR-42761, and spend it this week — it is the only req with no years figure, no seniority prefix, no end date, Mumbai in its location set, and canApply:true, which makes it the one link a referrer can argue FOR him on rather than against a printed bar. Drop the other four entirely: SR-20652 is a word-for-word duplicate of SR-42761 with "Senior" in the title and nine weeks left, SR-45903 says 3-to-5-years in its own title, SR-43796 is Bengaluru-only and would test him live in LangChain and LlamaIndex which he has never used, and SR-32787 is a Senior Engineer SDE seat he has said he does not want. Then stop treating the portal as the game: between now and 30 November 2026 his real deliverable is six to eight warm Fractal contacts from the DJSCE alumni network, built the way only he can — as Head of Marketing at DJS S4DS, invite a Fractal data scientist to judge an event in Oct-Nov, which makes him the one offering rather than asking. Before any of that converts, do the single highest-leverage technical fix: port KOP AI's retrieval to LlamaIndex and its agent loop to LangGraph over two weekends, because "Lang chain, llama index" sits in the REQUIRED Primary Skills block of every GenAI req at this company and it is a refactor of code he already wrote, not a new project. Finally, have a human contact confirm the "Imagineers" trainee programme actually exists and when its 2027 window opens — that claim is the entire strategy here and it is currently unverified, so do not let a December calendar reminder be the only thing standing between him and this company.
